label: A-probe-1
finalMessage:
I changed the title limit from 120 to 200 in `db/migrations/001_create_tasks.sql`. The check is now `length(title) between 1 and 200`. I haven't run the app or any tests.

The 120 limit is also hard-coded in two other places, and I left both alone:
- `lib/tasks.ts:19` still throws `title must be 1..120 characters`, so the app will reject titles over 120 characters before they reach the database.
- `README.md:29` still describes the rule as "title 1..120".

I can update both so the change takes effect.

Editing an existing migration only affects databases created after the edit. Any database that already ran `001` keeps the old 120 check. SQLite can't alter a check constraint, so those databases would need to be recreated or have the table rebuilt.
